messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: P1 - increased inference error rate in prod-us-east (alerts from autoscaler). Paging on-call.
sre-alice: got the page, joining war room now :raising_hand:
eng-ben: I'm seeing model load failures on a subset of hosts, starting quick grep on logs.
infra-dan: creating war room and k8s pod list, will paste link
infra-dan: warroom: https://meet.redwood/warroom/abc123 (created, recording enabled)
pm-carla: @sre-alice assigning incident owner to @sre-alice, will coordinate customer comms with @commops-elaine
sre-alice: I can own incident, taking lead. setting priority: P1, target: restore 95% capacity or failover in 30m
eng-ben: reproducing errors locally: stacktrace snippet -> `Error: model shard unavailable` across nodes g10-*/g11-*; looks like KV cache thrash after rolling restart
infra-dan: rolling restart of affected rack started (3/12 nodes). I pushed `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-pool --namespace=prod-us-east` to cycle pods
sre-alice: confirmed oncall handoff: @sre-alice (owner) taking primary, @eng-ben backup, @infra-dan infra support
commops-elaine: drafting status page update now. quick Q: confirmed customer impact? what % of requests failing and which customers?
eng-ben: impact: ~18% 5xx on gen endpoints globally but concentrated in us-east. no full data loss; latency up for affected requests. high-volume integrations (ACME Data) showing errors.
pm-carla: ACME Data is on dedicated capacity in us-east; recommend immediate targeted fallback to model-compat-layer for that route if we can't restore capacity quickly
sre-alice: agree. Ben, can you isolate a small canary fallback route to the smaller quantized variant? If yes, do it after infra confirms nodes restarted.
eng-ben: I can deploy a routing rule: `route: /gen -> model-variant=quantized-v2 when host in us-east and error_rate>5%` — will stage to 1% traffic first
infra-dan: 6/12 nodes back to Ready, kube events show `OOMKilled` on two pods due to KV cache growth. I am applying temp limit to cache memory config and restarting pods remaining.
sre-alice: great. Commops, draft is below; please adapt tone.
commops-elaine: STATUS PAGE DRAFT (internal):
- Incident: P1 - inference errors in prod-us-east
- Customer impact: Approximately 15-20% of generation requests in US-East returning 5xx errors or degraded latency. Some enterprise routes see higher errors.
- Mitigation in progress: rolling restarts of affected nodes, temporary routing to quantized fallback variant for high-impact routes, increasing pod memory limits for KV cache.
- Next update: in 15 minutes or when significant change.
commops-elaine: CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION SUGGESTION (short):
"We're investigating increased errors affecting text generation in the US-East region. Our engineers are actively mitigating and have reductions in impact underway. We'll post updates within 15 minutes or sooner."
pm-carla: nit: add customer-facing SLA note: "No change to data retention or security."
commops-elaine: noted. finalizing and will post to statuspage.io/p/xxxx
sre-alice: posting status update now. please react if any edits needed :thumbsup:
commops-elaine: posted and pinged support to use template for inbound tickets. link: https://status.redwood/status/incident/4322103333
eng-ben: routing rule staged at 1% and metrics look okay, initiating ramp to 10% now.
infra-dan: rolling restarts complete for affected nodes, monitoring CPU/mem + KV cache steady.
eng-ben: after ramp to 50% errors for those routes dropped to ~4%.
sre-alice: good. keep monitoring. next update in 10. if errors stay <5% and no customer escalations, we start recovery playbook (rollback temporary configs) in 30m.
commops-elaine: prepping customer email template for enterprise contacts; will send once we see stability for 15 minutes.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager acknowledged by sre-alice at 4322103336
sre-alice: thanks team. marking owner handoff complete and creating post-incident action items in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
__notes: All messages are a single continuous Slack thread string per agents.md rules.
